# Contributing to mdPreview

Thanks for helping! mdPreview is a small, offline macOS Markdown viewer and editor. Bug reports, fixes, translations and documentation improvements are all welcome.

## Set up

You need macOS 13+, Python 3.13 and Node 22+.

```bash
python3.13 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements/lock.txt -r requirements/dev.txt
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run vendor        # regenerates vendor/ from the locked npm packages
npx playwright install chromium webkit
```

## Run the checks

```bash
npm test                              # JavaScript unit suites (jsdom)
.venv/bin/python scripts/test-python.py   # Python suites + coverage gate (core modules ≥ 90%)
npm run test:e2e                      # Playwright, Chromium + WebKit
scripts/build.sh                     # build mdPreview.app into WorkSpace/dist
.venv/bin/python scripts/verify-headless.py --app WorkSpace/dist/release-$(cat VERSION)/mdPreview.app
```

`WorkSpace/` is git-ignored scratch space for build products, logs, caches and local evidence. **Tests, fixtures and CI live in `tests/` and `.github/` and are committed.**

## Project layout

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.html`, `app.js`, `frontend/` | UI running inside WKWebView (plain scripts, no bundler) |
| `css/` | `tokens.css` (design tokens, light/dark/output), `content.css` (document typography, the single source for screen/print/export), `app.css` (chrome), `print.css` |
| `mdPreview.py`, `mdpreview_core/` | Native shell (pywebview + PyObjC): windows, menus, file IO, printing, PDF post-processing, updates |
| `vendor/` | Third-party JS (generated by `scripts/vendor.mjs`, checksummed, licenses included) |
| `tests/` | JS + Python tests, Playwright specs, fixtures |
| `scripts/` | Build, verification, release and CLI helpers |

## Making a change

1. Write a failing test first (`tests/test_*.js` or `tests/test_*.py`; browser behaviour goes in `tests/e2e/`).
2. Implement the change. Route every native call through `Bridge.call(...)` in the frontend.
3. Output-related changes (print, PDF, Word, HTML, PNG) must keep `tests/test_output_quality.py` and `scripts/verify-headless.py` green.
4. User-visible strings go through `t('English', '中文')` and must be added to the locale files (`node scripts/extract-i18n.mjs` regenerates them; `--check` verifies).
5. Keep commits focused, with a message that says what and why.

## Ground rules

- No network access except the opt-in update check and user-approved remote images.
- Never relax the global DOMPurify configuration; new renderers get their own restricted configuration.
- No inline event handlers or `eval`; the page ships with a strict Content-Security-Policy.
- New third-party code must come through `scripts/vendor.mjs` with its license.
- Never commit private keys, tokens, real documents or personal paths. Release signing keys are not part of this repository.
- Do not modify an installed `/Applications/mdPreview.app` during development.

## Reporting security issues

Please follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities.
